gates.V1: fresh unchanged legacy replay: byte-identical case generation, aggregate trace, legacy solute fields, and all active hydraulic fields
gates.V2: explicit indexed one-species exact reduction including traces, aggregate fields, per-species fields, events, conservation, and hydraulics
gates.V7: standalone/combined per-species traces and fields plus cellwise aggregate and every aggregate mass/rate/residual sum
gates.V10: every species/time and aggregate trace plus final-field-integrated conservation and extracted-mass bounds
gates.V11: finite/nonnegative fields and traces, monotonic cumulative and remaining states, beginning-step source cap, and unclamped diagnostics
gates.V12: two fresh serial runs: input, all dictionaries, initial fields, traces, final species/aggregate/hydraulic fields, and compact result hashes
gates.V13: one serial and two MPI runs: repeated traces/reconstructed fields, every species/time, aggregate, conservation, hydraulics, and events
gates.V14: coarse/intermediate/fine timestep comparison of all species and aggregate masses, concentrations, rates, residuals, first drip, and target event
gates.V16: direct legacy/indexed equality of every active hydraulic/mechanical field, trace, and event; predeclared NOT_APPLICABLE only
gates.V17: individually named rejection tests for every owner-enumerated category; no Boolean placeholder
gates.V18: stable declared species ordering and naming in dictionaries, fields, and traces

v16_not_applicable.effective_stress_field: not written by the production solver; active mechanics is covered by direct porosity/permeability fields and stress/compaction traces
v16_not_applicable.mechanical_porosity_field: the active porosity field is mechanical porosity in the mechanics case
v16_not_applicable.compaction_permeability_ratio_field: permeability is compared directly and the ratio is compared through minimumPermeabilityRatio

claim_ceiling: Generic indexed conservative passive-species software and numerical verification only; physical validation NOT_ESTABLISHED.
